_what: A person's optional unique public name (src/person-names.mjs makePersonNames), layered on the opaque store id that stays the only key: it is shown instead of a random code and is the readable address of their link-in-bio page (/l/<name>, src/link-page-pages.mjs), while the page's random code keeps working. One name points at one holder at a time: its claim owner is one record book per name (src/book-handlers.mjs 'person-name'), the first holder to claim it keeps it until that holder releases it, and `kv_prefix` + name is the read index ({ holder, code }) the public page resolves. A change of name claims the new one and releases the old one, so a released name may be claimed by someone else. A name matches `pattern`, never looks like a random code, and never takes a `reserved` word. `words` are every refusal.

words.refused: A name is 3 to 30 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, like sam-rivera.
words.reserved: That name is kept for Trillion. Choose another.
words.taken: Someone else already has that name. Choose another.
words.not_here: Names cannot be claimed here. Change your name from the Link in bio screen or set_link_page.
